milestone.title: Decide goreleaser vs manual tap-update path

intent.outcome: stable-ci.yml's manual tap-update path is the single canonical release path. .goreleaser.yml is removed and the decision is recorded in DESIGN.md so future maintainers don't relitigate.

problem.description: .goreleaser.yml exists at repo root (50 lines, configured for darwin/linux × amd64/arm64 + homebrew tap integration) but is not invoked from any workflow. stable-ci.yml has its own manual sed-based tap-update job that we just used successfully for v1.0.0-rc1. Two release paths co-existing is confusing and risks future drift.

in_scope: Add a release-path decision entry to DESIGN.md (manual tap-update path is canonical; goreleaser was considered and rejected because the manual path is already working and the release cadence is low).
Verify no workflow references goreleaser after removal.

acceptance_criteria.description: .goreleaser.yml is deleted; stable-ci.yml manual tap-update path is the single canonical release path.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: test ! -f .goreleaser.yml; grep -L goreleaser .github/workflows/*.yml (no workflow references goreleaser)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test ! -f .goreleaser.yml returns true (file deleted, HEAD 3759a5e); grep -l goreleaser .github/workflows/*.yml returns no matches (no workflow references goreleaser); drift sweep: no remaining 'goreleaser' references in AGENTS.md or check_dependencies.sh after M07 follow-up sweep

acceptance_criteria.description: DESIGN.md documents the release-path decision: manual tap-update path is canonical, goreleaser was considered and rejected.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: grep -i goreleaser DESIGN.md shows a decision-log entry explaining the choice
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M07 self-verification: .goreleaser.yml deleted, no workflow references goreleaser, DESIGN.md decision-log entry added. Release path: manual stable-ci.yml tap-update. .gitignore unaffected (file removed cleanly via git rm).

steps.action: Delete .goreleaser.yml from repo root and verify no workflow references goreleaser.
steps.done_when: .goreleaser.yml is deleted and no .github/workflows/*.yml file references 'goreleaser'.

steps.action: Add a release-path decision entry to DESIGN.md explaining why manual tap-update is canonical and goreleaser was rejected.
steps.tests: manual: grep -i goreleaser DESIGN.md shows the decision entry
steps.done_when: DESIGN.md contains a decision-log entry about the release path that mentions goreleaser and the rationale.

verification.evidence: M07 self-verification: .goreleaser.yml deleted, no workflow references goreleaser, DESIGN.md decision-log entry added. Release path: manual stable-ci.yml tap-update. .gitignore unaffected (file removed cleanly via git rm).
